[SWS_ComM_01102] Call of ComM_SetECUGroupClassification
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09071, SRS_ModeMgm_09157
⌈If ComM_SetECUGroupClassification is called, ComM shall update the internal
status field with the values of the given inhibition status (Status).⌋
Note: A change of the internal status field has no impact on a activated inhibition
function (see 7.4.1.4.2 “Wake up inhibition - example 2” for an example)
